name: MUSES8832
tagline: The low-voltage MUSES: 2.1 nV/√Hz, rail-to-rail output into 600 Ω from 2.7 V, for battery headphone amps.

lineage.note: Announced Sep 2014, mass production Oct 2014; leadless KW1 added 2016. No second source.
New JRC merged into Nisshinbo 2022. No die change, PCN or 'A' successor found.

part_numbers.note: Base type, introduced Sep 2014. No vendor DIP8 version.
SOP-8 (EMP8 outline); -TE1 is tape and reel. Stocked at Mouser, DigiKey, LCSC.
Small leadless package added 2016; outline name and current stock unconfirmed.

key_specs.value: 2.7–13 V total (±1.35 V min); 15 V max (unverified)

reputation.summary: A niche but well-liked MUSES in the Japanese DIY and portable scene, chosen when a low-voltage or battery supply rules out the others. A Zigsow review ('低電圧で使えて優しい音質') finds it gentler than the OPA2134 with MUSES-like transparency. Stereo magazine groups it with MUSES8820 and MUSES8920 as mass-production MUSES. No ASR or other measurements found.
typical_uses: portable devices and smartphones (vendor target; KW1)
low-voltage single-supply audio stages from +2.7 V
caveats: No vendor DIP8; DIP8 'units' are SOP8 on adapters, with layout and stability risk.
Low-voltage part: about 13 V operating, 15 V max. Not for ±15 V rails.
Praise is almost all Japanese subjective reviews; no independent measurements.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit reports. As a low-volume SMD-only part it is likely a lesser target. Buy from Mouser, DigiKey or Kyohritsu eleshop. Any 'MUSES8832 DIP8' is SOP8 on an adapter; buy those from known vendors such as Audiophonics.

claims_confirmed: English datasheet is Ver. 10 'Rail-to-Rail Output, High Quality Audio, Dual Operational Amplifier' (https://www.endrich.com/Datenbl%C3%A4tter/Aktive%20Komponenten/MUSES8832_E.pdf; https://file.bettlink.com/product/datasheet/5048863/muses8832.pdf).
Japanese datasheet Ver. 5 on the Kyohritsu mirror (https://www.kyohritsu.com/eclib/OTHER/DATASHEET/JRC/muses8832.pdf).

2.1 nV/√Hz, 10 MHz, 0.0009% THD, 600 Ω drive, −40 to +125 °C (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/products/operational-amplifier/spec/?product=muses8832; https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/808063/NJRC/MUSES8832.html).

MUSES8832E-TE1 sold as a SOP8 unit (https://www.audiophonics.fr/en/opa/muses8832e-p-18950.html).
Leadless MUSES8920KX7 and MUSES8832KW1 added in 2016 (https://xtech.nikkei.com/dm/atcl/news/15yk/090600479/).
Legacy NJR and current Nisshinbo pages exist (https://www.njr.co.jp/products/MUSES/series/MUSES8832.html; https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/ja/MUSES/series/MUSES8832.html).
semi_20160902 is the MUSES03 sample announcement (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/about/info/njr/2016/semi_20160902.html).
refuted_claims: Leadless suffix is KW1, not KX7; KX7 is the MUSES8920 version.

Not 'status unknown': actively stocked at Mouser, DigiKey and JLCPCB/LCSC; vendor pages live.
